quote: Upon a highway which has been divided into three clearly marked lanes, a vehicle must not be driven in the extreme left lane at any time. A vehicle on such a highway must not be driven in the center lane except: (a) When overtaking and passing another vehicle where the highway is clearly visible and the center lane is clear of traffic for a safe distance; (b) In preparation for a left turn; or (c) When the center lane is allocated exclusively to traffic moving in the direction in which the vehicle is proceeding and a sign is posted to give notice of such allocation.

activation.condition: Highway divided into three clearly marked lanes; vehicle lane occupancy observed.

obligation.description: Do not drive in extreme left lane at any time; center lane use is limited to the three stated exceptions.

exceptions.source_clause: When overtaking and passing another vehicle where the highway is clearly visible and the center lane is clear of traffic for a safe distance
exceptions.description: Passing with visible highway and center lane clear for a safe distance

exceptions.source_clause: In preparation for a left turn
When the center lane is allocated exclusively to traffic moving in the direction in which the vehicle is proceeding and a sign is posted to give notice of such allocation
exceptions.description: Exclusive same-direction allocation with posted notice

timing.description: Extreme-left prohibition applies at any time; center exception is assessed during its maneuver interval.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Physical lane marking visibility and three-lane geometry are independently reviewed.
Passing sight is a physical line-of-sight question, not a map assertion.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: clear of traffic for a safe distance
judgment_calls_needed.note: No numerical legal distance is supplied.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: In preparation for a left turn
judgment_calls_needed.note: Intent and preparation require source motion and context beyond a route request.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: allocated exclusively to traffic moving in the direction in which the vehicle is proceeding and a sign is posted
judgment_calls_needed.note: Map direction and candidate prop do not establish allocation authority or posted notice text.
